task: fix(dispatch): a load hold is not starvation, and a shared session says nothing about one item. Interface: in fleet-dispatch `cmd_starved` returns 0 while the load gates hold the queue, and every other gate still trips it. In `waiting_sessions` (what `cmd_reap` reads from `agent-panel list --json`, rows `{target: "hub/dotfiles:2", status}`), a session is shared when its target names more than one Claude window (the same part before the `:N`; a row whose status is `shell` is not a Claude window): it says nothing about any one item, so it neither flips its items to waiting nor leaves a false waiting standing. A session with one Claude window keeps flipping its item to waiting as before.
accept: reap: a session several Claudes share says nothing about one item, so it never flips to waiting and a false waiting comes back
